text:
Mira S: Heads up — noticed dashboard spike in p99 for /v1/generate right after we flipped the 'route affinity' rollout to 60% this morning. p50/p95 look stable but p99 jumps ~300ms. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
Alex K: saw it, yep. likely tail from sticky routing sending some long-running client sessions to a handful of backends. p50 unaffected because median balanced. p99 sensitive to a few slow outliers.
Samir: can we confirm whether the p99 is coming from a specific endpoint variant or from client segmentation? iirc we merge route variants in the rollup which can hide that.
Mira S: good point. Dashboard currently shows endpoint breakdown by 'route', but not by 'route affinity group'. i tried drilling with the query:
```
SELECT percentile(0.99, latency_ms) FROM requests
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND ts > now() - 1h
GROUP BY route, client_id_hash_bucket
```
but that's heavy to run in the UI.
Jamie L: maybe the console needs a lightweight decomposition: show percentiles by 'affinity' toggle (sticky vs stateless) + a small sample count column. UX idea: default p99 chart remains but add a 'show affinity split' checkbox that expands a mini stacked view.
Alex K: from infra side, we also saw a bump in request serialization time on two nodes that were in the affinity group. low qps but big variance. I pushed a hotfix to route-affinity scheduling (rebalanced sticky buckets).
DeployBot: deploy alpha/route-affinity v2.3.1 -> prod at 1744444520 :white_check_mark:
Samir: thanks. Is the p99 computation coming from sampled telemetry or full telemetry? if sampled, a small sample skew could amplify. we should surface sample_count next to every percentile in the console.
Mira S: agreed. small sample_count + high p99 = noisy signal. for this case sample_count was only ~120 in the last 10m for the affected affine group.
Alex K: Suggestion: we add an annotation on the p99 metric when sample_count < threshold (e.g., <500) and show a tooltip: "low sample count — percentile may be noisy". also add a route-affinity toggle so folks can split by affinity without running heavy queries.
Jamie L: UI mockup incoming — will add a compact sparkline per affinity bucket and sample_count badge. can we get a product decision on whether default expands to show affinity or keep it opt-in?
Mira S: opt-in for now. we don't want to overwhelm default view. opt-in with a prominent tooltip & quick link to the raw query would be ideal.
Samir: also propose we augment backend percentile rollup to store per-affinity aggregates (tdigest per bucket) for the last-6h so UI can fetch fast. tradeoff: more rollup cardinality.
Alex K: agree, tdigest per-affinity + retention 6h seems reasonable. infra cost should be small compared to the debugging win.
Jamie L: I'll coordinate a short RFC with mock and the sample_count annotation text. cc @Mira S and @Alex K for review.
Mira S: thanks all — once the annotation and toggle are in i'll re-check the p99 trend and confirm whether the hotfix normalized it. :thumbsup:
